notes.title: Grippy Golf is Now Available!
notes.notes: Hey all, after over a year of hard work, Grippy Golf is now available!  Try it out, and let me know what you think!

notes.title: Dev Demo Live Stream + Q&A (2 of 2)
notes.notes:
Join me as I play Grippy Golf live for Steam Next Fest!

I will be trying to improve my times on each level while also answering your questions.

Join me in playing! Maybe you'll even be able to surpass me.
